rows.notes: v1 had under_construction from a Nov 2024 groundbreaking. The 2025 annual report lists 滁州 among domestic bases already built (建成生产基地); its construction-in-progress table separately carries a 滁州国轩高性能刀片电池项目 (new project, still being built at end-2025), so site is operational with an expansion under way. No GWh figure found in any open source (Chinese-language search run; no gov/press page with Chuzhou GWh); nameplate/installed left null rather than guessed. v1 chemistry string was not in vocabulary and unverified, nulled. 滁州 aggregator list (S42 page) also marks it 已投产 with no capacity. Coordinates untouched. Row is not known to be >=10 GWh.

v1 said operational / start_year 2025 / installed implied. Company FAQ: Phase 1 (storage product / pack assembly) operational; cell manufacturing is Phase 2 ('will expand to LFP battery manufacturing'). The 2025 annual report carries 'Gotion Illinois New Energy Inc ... 电池厂建设项目' as construction in progress (~67.97% of budget at end-2025). A 2026-08 aggregator (S42 page) says '部分产线投产，全面投产推迟至2026年' for Illinois. Furthest stage reached for CELL production = under_construction; no source found saying in-house cells have been produced as of 2026-11 (search run; Energy-Storage.News said cells planned for 2026 but page not openable). start_year therefore null (v1 2025 was pack start). Nameplate 40 GWh cells (+10 GWh packs excluded) from 2023 announcement; no source gives a dated full-capacity year (v1 2034 not found on any page fetched: EDC page and Manufacturing Dive both give only 'begin production 2024'); ref_year: fallback, searched (2023 = source publication year). cell_format null (unconfirmed). Big Rapids MI plant (not in DB) reported dead Oct 2025, see operator_sites CSV.

Not a separate site: the only evidence is that GWh-scale sodium-ion lines run 'in Tangshan and Hefei' (Gnascent launch, May 2026). No site name, address or capacity for a distinct Hefei sodium plant; v1 coordinates are identical to the Hefei Xinzhan VW row (31.86389,117.28083). Sodium lines are folded into the Hefei and Tangshan cell rows as a note. Caveat: the sodium line may sit at a different Hefei plant than Xinzhan; if so it is a line within an unidentified Hefei site, still not a separate row with sourced capacity.

is_cell_manufacturer=false: annual report shows Lujiang assets are materials plants (庐江材料厂房, 庐江科宏 20万吨 cathode) and no open source shows cell production there (only an Aug 2025 new small-power subsidiary with no GWh). v1 10 GWh cell figure (from park/trade summaries; sources 403 to fetch) could not be re-confirmed, nulled. Site is predominantly a battery MATERIALS base (annual report: 庐江科宏年产20万吨高端正极材料项目 completed). Cell content is uncertain: a 2025-08 filing shows a new 65%-owned subsidiary 合肥国轩吉泰美 (small-power cells) registered in Lujiang with no GWh disclosed; older reports (search snippets only, not fetched) mention a 6 GWh cylindrical project built ~2017. Status operational rests only on a third-party aggregator listing 庐江国轩 as 已投产 (corroboration-grade). Lead should decide whether this row is in cell scope; weak evidence, low confidence. Not >=10 GWh now (null).

installed basis: government (Nanjing investment bureau, 2025-10-23: Liuhe base capacity 28 GWh). v1 had 30 GWh (2022) as installed-like; now 28. Aggregator (S42 page) says cumulative 'close to 50 GWh' for Nanjing, unreliable, not used. Annual report also lists a 江苏国轩 CIP at 87% progress. Chemistry/format/end-market of v1 unverified, nulled.

Same city and identical coordinates (39.64381,118.18319) as the Tangshan Guoxuan plant row; the source only says GWh-scale sodium-ion lines run in Tangshan and Hefei, giving no separate site or capacity. Treated as lines inside the existing Tangshan plant (noted in that row).

Removed (reason not_found): no open source states built/under-construction/operating status. Filing only shows a RMB 813.5m syndicated loan for the 'phase 1 (5GWh)' base (balance RMB 657.98m at 2025-12-31), an associate with long-term losses whose parent listed its 47.4% stake for RMB 1. Also not a Gotion-operated site. Earlier notes: COULD NOT VERIFY. v1 rested on an Argus article (paid source, forbidden by open-data rule C5) from 2020. Open sources fetched today: Shanghai Electric / Chinese pages 503 or 521. What the 2025 annual report does say: Shanghai Electric Gotion is an ASSOCIATE (联营企业), not a Gotion subsidiary; in June 2024 Gotion guaranteed 49% of a RMB 813.5m syndicated loan for its 'Nantong energy-storage system base phase 1 (5GWh)'; and Gotion carries 40% bad-debt provisions on receivables from the Shanghai Electric Gotion entities (RMB 172.9m / 147.0m / 77.6m) - a distress signal. Operator in this row (Gotion) is therefore not the operator; the owner is Shanghai Electric/Gotion associate. Status/capacity set to null because no open quote supports them; lead may want to remove the row or have a later task re-verify (older reports: 5 GWh phase 1 full capacity Sept 2020, 10 GWh planned). Also: v1 coordinates (31.222,121.458) are Shanghai city centre, not Nantong - wrong. Annual-report quote not attached as evidence because it does not state status.
